obligations.expected_behavior: Reconcile every entry in the complete current Consumer Manifest to its corresponding repository callers, covering VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing.
forbidden_result: Any current Consumer Manifest entry lacks a corresponding repository caller.
The reconciliation omits VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing callers.
obligations.observable_result: A reconciliation record demonstrates that each Consumer Manifest entry is represented by repository callers in all named scopes.
obligations.state_after: Every entry of the complete current Consumer Manifest has a corresponding repository caller across VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing.
obligations.state_before: The mapping from Consumer Manifest entries to repository callers is not established as complete.
obligations.subject: Consumer Manifest entries and repository callers
obligations.trigger: When performing the required bidirectional reconciliation.

obligations.expected_behavior: Reconcile every repository caller back to an entry in the complete current Consumer Manifest, covering VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing.
forbidden_result: Any repository caller lacks a corresponding Consumer Manifest entry.
The reverse reconciliation omits VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing callers.
obligations.observable_result: A reconciliation record demonstrates that each repository caller in the named scopes is represented in the complete current Consumer Manifest.
obligations.state_after: Every repository caller in VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing has a corresponding entry in the complete current Consumer Manifest.
obligations.state_before: The reverse mapping from repository callers to Consumer Manifest entries is not established as complete.
obligations.subject: Repository callers and Consumer Manifest entries
obligations.trigger: When performing the required bidirectional reconciliation.
